text:
maya: Hey @kevin — customer hitting weird rerank behavior. They call /v1/rerank and get 200 but scores all 0 or identical. Payload attached. Repro minimal below.

maya: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \n -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"query":"how to reset","documents":[{"id":"d1","query":"how to reset password","text":"..."}],"candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Reset steps..."}]}'```

maya: Notice they put a "query" field inside documents too (accidentally). When we flatten, scores are fine.

kevin: can you paste the full JSON? is it 422 or 200?

maya: 200, but scores are zeros. customer-side logs show all candidates score 0. There is no error in API logs but response shape is valid.

sam: could be schema precedence: top-level query takes precedence, but nested query might override candidate matching and cause fallback scoring?

eli: @maya can you repro without auth side effects? any chance they mix 'passages' and 'candidates' arrays?

maya: Minimal repro I used:

maya: ```json
{
  "documents":[
    {"id":"1","query":"how to reset","text":"steps..."},
    {"id":"2","text":"other stuff"}
  ],
  "candidates":[
    {"id":"c1","text":"do X"}
  ]
}
```

maya: note top-level query missing.

kevin: ok that's likely the bug. Rerank expects top-level "query" or provides default empty query -> zero scores. Add fix suggestion.

kevin: temporary workaround: always include top-level "query": "..." even if docs have their own query fields.

sam: can we add validation to return 422 when nested query fields found? That would surface earlier.

eli: +1, also log a warning for mixed 'passages' vs 'candidates'.

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-987, tag=rerank-schema. Assigned to eng-ml.

maya: customer wants repro steps to share with their devs. Can we provide minimal curl they can copy?

kevin: I'll send a sanitized curl in a sec.

kevin: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"query":"how to reset password","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"Reset via settings"},{"id":"c2","text":"Contact support"}]}'```

maya: thanks — forwarding to customer. tagging @eli for possible quick validation patch.

eli: I'll add a runtime warning and a unit test, can we aim for a small patch tomorrow? :thumbsup:

maya: thanks all. customer says they're on a tight timeline; any ETA for a fix?

eli: I'll try for a hotfix within 48h, otherwise we'll add docs and validation in next patch.

maya: closing loop once customer confirms.
